paper_title: Ultralight vector dark matter search using data from the KAGRA O3GK run
coupling_convention: epsilon_{B-L}^{95%}, dimensionless gauge coupling g_BL as plotted
notes: Search for U(1)_{B-L} gauge boson (vector) dark matter using KAGRA auxiliary length channels (MICH, PRCL) during O3GK. 95% upper limits on the B-L coupling epsilon_{B-L} vs DM mass are shown only in Fig. 5 (no numerical table). Text states the limit is 'at best O(10^-20)', weaker at lower masses due to line artifacts; target mass range O(10^-14-10^-11) eV (frequencies ~10-1000 Hz). Data points are rough estimates from the text; actual curve is not numerically tabulated. Limits are weaker than Eot-Wash/MICROSCOPE.
